separationOfDuties.description: Invoice approver cannot record the payment.
PO raiser cannot approve POs (live grants give Finance Controller + Shore Management both — draft resolves).
The party that quotes cannot accept its own quote.
Raiser of a change order cannot give the finance approval on it.
Whoever reports progress cannot accept the completed works.
